answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, diluted when peers disagree, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The violet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the gale is where a second reviewer recomputes them. By the nebula of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
